policy.name: bounded full-turn beam, real enemy response
policy.horizon: One player turn and its enemy response
policy.ranking: Preserves focus setup with remaining attacks and a small hand-size potential; stable ties prefer fewer plays. Residual resources have zero value after victory or defeat.
policy.rewards: Highest exported rewardScore; one chosen card at every reward. Same formula and policy across both rulesets.
policy.path: Moon, library, rest at every stop in full runs. First-stop alternatives are independently replayed.
policy.oracleWarning: Search sees deterministic within-turn draw outcomes. Not an optimal policy or a model of human knowledge, enjoyment, discoverability, or play duration.

definitions.timeProxy: Sum of player turns actually examined in reached battles. Report reach counts; early defeats can artificially lower total turns.
definitions.comboPlays: A played card with one or more exported comboTags conditions active. Multiple tags count once as a combo play. Passive origin effects excluded.
definitions.rewardCardPlays: Play of a base ID acquired as a reward; classic may already have that ID, so this does not identify individual copies.
definitions.actionsPerTurn: Card plays plus end-turn presses divided by observed player turns. Excludes menu decisions.
definitions.rewardTypes: Static mechanical grouping, not a quality rating. Setup requirements differ by acquired deck and encounter.
definitions.damageTaken: Actual stats.taken, not net HP change; healing cannot hide damage.
definitions.campBranches: Exact same save/RNG after battle 2 through battle 3 only; five alternatives. Low/full HP copies are explicit synthetic probes, not naturally observed rates.
definitions.pairing: Seeds and origins matched, but different decks/reward pools consume RNG differently. Later encounters are survivor-conditioned. Removal also changes shuffle order.

saveAudit.method: Every executed action is replayed from public export/restore; compare exact next save and RNG. Every reached terminal state round-tripped.
